page.notes: Printed text is set in roman with long s rendered as plain s throughout. "Examneron" as printed is "Examerον"-type spelling; transcribed as printed in Latin letters, but the word may read "Exameron" (the printed form looks like "Examneron"); doubtful. "Caleca" and "Hottingero" are proper names as printed. The Greek "Ancient" names are in Latin letters as printed.
